reports.title: Dorman Products, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Updates 2026 Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: The Company updates its full-year 2026 guidance as detailed in the table below. The Company's guidance includes the expected impact of tariffs enacted as of October 26, 2026. The Company’s guidance excludes the impact of potential tariff changes after October 26, 2026, future acquisitions and divestitures, and additional share repurchases.

Updated 2026 Guidance | Prior 2026 Guidance
Net Sales Growth vs. 2025 | 2% – 3% | 3% – 5%
Diluted EPS | $7.95 – $8.15 | $7.93 – $8.23
Growth vs. 2025 | 20% – 23% | 19% – 24%
Adjusted Diluted EPS* | $8.50 – $8.70 | $8.50 – $8.80
Growth vs. 2025 | (4)% – (2)% | (4)% – (1)%
Tax Rate Estimate | 23.5% – 24.0% | 23.5%
